definitions.explanation: Describes something that can be done without much effort or difficulty. More formal and literary than やさしい or 簡単.

examples.japanese: たやすいこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たやすく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たやすく⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't easily change habits built up over many years.

notes:
たやすい can also be written as {容易|たやす}い. It is more formal than ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧ or やさしい and is often used in negative constructions to emphasize difficulty.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- たやすいこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: it's no easy matter
- たやすく〜⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: cannot easily ~
- たやすく⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to be easily obtained

USAGE: More commonly encountered in written Japanese and formal speech. In casual conversation, ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧ or ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧ are preferred.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: easy, simple (most common, neutral)
- やさしい: easy (common, slightly softer tone)
- たやすい: easy (formal, literary)
- ⟦{容易|ようい}→容易：12316_youi⟧: easy (formal, often in ⟦{容易|ようい}→容易：12316_youi⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧)
